tools.name: esearch
tools.description: Search an NCBI database and retrieve a list of UIDs matching the query. Databases include: pubmed, protein, nuccore, nucleotide, gene, genome, and more. Returns up to retmax results (default 20, max 100000).

term.description: Search query using Entrez search syntax

retmax.description: Maximum number of UIDs to return (default: 20)

tools.name: efetch
tools.description: Retrieve formatted data records from an NCBI database using UIDs. Returns full records in various formats (xml, json, text, fasta, gb, etc.).

id.description: Comma-separated list of UIDs to fetch

tools.name: esummary
tools.description: Retrieve document summaries (DocSums) from an NCBI database using UIDs. Returns condensed information about records.

tools.name: einfo
tools.description: Get information about available Entrez databases or detailed field information for a specific database. Call without db parameter to list all databases.

db.description: Database name (optional - omit to list all databases)

tools.name: elink
tools.description: Retrieve UIDs of related records in the same or different databases, or retrieve linkout URLs. Useful for finding related articles, genes, proteins, etc.

db.description: Target database (can be same as dbfrom)

id.description: Comma-separated list of UIDs from source database

tools.name: egquery
tools.description: Provides counts of search results across all Entrez databases for a single query. Useful for determining which databases contain relevant results.

tools.name: espell
tools.description: Retrieve spelling suggestions for a text query in a specific database. Helps correct misspelled search terms.
